jobs.description: Voxius is a specialized executive search firm in the Legal & Compliance sector. Our work with and for leaders in key positions gives us a unique vantage point to help level the playing field and create equal opportunities for all candidates. Fortunately, a growing number of clients are engaging us to diversify their legal departments. We support our clients' efforts in this regard, as a more diverse team reflects the society served by legal professionals. Furthermore, we play an active role ourselves in building diverse teams: we use effective methods to recruit and promote candidates from diverse backgrounds and strongly encourage our clients to select a diverse shortlist. We believe that a focus on diversity and inclusion is not only a social responsibility but also offers companies a unique and crucial competitive advantage. Research shows that diverse and inclusive organizations are more innovative, make better decisions, and bring new ideas to market faster. It's a win-win situation for everyone. English Diversity & Inclusion (D&I) remains a hot topic. We define diversity as the variation in personal, physical, and social characteristics, such as gender, ethnicity, age, and education. Inclusion is about each person feeling valued and welcome. In simple terms, diversity is the mix, and inclusion is making that mix work well together. Today, the lack of diversity in business-particularly at the board level-is still evident. Within the legal profession as well, there is still progress to be made in diversifying departments and firms. In addition to hiring a diverse workforce, attention must also be paid to salary transparency and pay equity-that is, equal pay for equal work. Voxius is a specialist executive search firm focused on legal and compliance.
